items.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report: Multi-Head Latent Attention & Mixture-of-Experts Architecture
items.tldr: DeepSeek-V3 achieves state-of-the-art performance using Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architecture for high efficiency training and inference.
items.why_it_matters: Demonstrates massive parameter efficiency and lower cost for frontier LLM reasoning.

items.title: Show HN: Open Source Autonomous Agentic Workflow Framework
items.tldr: A lightweight Python engine for orchestrating asynchronous LLM agent teams with tools, vector memory, and self-correction loops.
items.why_it_matters: Simplifies multi-agent systems integration for production applications.

items.title: Anthropic Announces Claude 3.5 Sonnet Artifacts and Computer Use Capabilities
items.tldr: Claude 3.5 Sonnet introduces API support for direct GUI control, allowing models to interpret screens, move cursors, and click UI elements.
items.why_it_matters: Unlocks next-generation desktop automation and browser agent workflows.
